entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Mi sedi, Ala, a’tagi lang mi andu mi julane. Mijabi heh wasude dole ang de heh mountinare ma, heh wasude am heh kebal ma ang. Wode Ala godo sina mada, walo wo fowu darani do hore
